other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
Applicant must have his own fruit orchard.
Applicant must have an irrigation source.
Work can be started only after administrative approval/work order issued by the Horticulture Department.
Verification of the establishment can be done by the committee formed.
Grant amount can be paid directly into the farmer's bank account or to the producing firm based on the farmer's written consent.
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy on installation costs, up to a maximum area of 5,000 sq m.
